description: 河川水の分析状況(多摩川) [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 狛江市. 令和３年度「統計こまえ」に掲載された河川水の分析状況（多摩川）です。 （資料） ・環境部環境政策課「狛江のかんきょう」 ・多摩川水系水質監視連絡協議会「多摩川及び関連河川水質合同調査結果」 （注意事項） ・測定点：多摩川 多摩川世田谷区境 ・年２回採取の平均値 ・「＜＊. ＊＊」は定量下限値未満を表している ・「※」は測定値のいずれかに定... Coverage: 狛江市. The portal files it under the publisher 狛江市. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
